message: 一人では生きられない

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way?!」
I couldn't believe my ears.
As I was casually walking down a path on the academy grounds, the unmistakable sound of a roasted sweet potato vendor suddenly echoed out without any restraint.
A man was walking away toward the main gate. A roasted sweet potato cart had been parked there.
Melilot-san was holding a paper bag containing several roasted sweet potatoes in her hands. It looked like she had just bought some.

name: Melilot
message: 「T-This is not what it looks like, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Melilot
message: 「All necessary information and goods can be obtained online.」
...What is she suddenly talking about?

name: Melilot
message: 「Naturally, roasted sweet potatoes can also be purchased via mail order, however...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Presumably as a result of prioritizing shelf life and ease of transport, they are all soaked in preservatives and have a sour taste.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see...」

name: Melilot
message: 「To state my logical conclusion first, those things may be called roasted sweet potatoes, yet they are no roasted sweet potatoes at all.」
So they just tasted awful, yeah.

name: Melilot
message: 「At the same time, I heard rumors that there is a roasted sweet potato stall in Ryuusei Town reputed to be exceptionally delicious.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Unfortunately, they do not offer mail order, so I asked Helena and Riesling to go buy some for me.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Upon tasting them, they were indeed delicious, yet they had inevitably cooled down during delivery, making it difficult to say I had truly researched them.」
Y-You don't have to go out of your way to investigate it...

name: Melilot
message: 「While I was pondering how to obtain and examine them freshly made, I learned that although mail order is impossible, they do take delivery orders, so I had him come here.」
Ryuusei Academy is strictly off-limits to unauthorized personnel on weekdays, though... What kind of connections does she have?

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun?」
Still, it's rare for Melilot-san to speak so talkatively on her own initiative. Since I have the chance, I might as well hear her out.

name: Melilot
message: 「S-Sweet potatoes yield roughly twice the calories per unit area compared to rice. They are an extraordinarily efficient and rational food source.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Furthermore, this paper bag is crafted by folding old newspaper. Both its shape and durability are impeccable--truly fascinating.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, there is just one point I cannot comprehend.」

name: Melilot
message: 「The roasted sweet potatoes Helena and Riesling bought for me were all round」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, despite having purchased them at the exact same stall, the ones I have on hand are all long and slender... Could this simply be a coincidence?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nope, it's all in how you order them」

name: Synn
message: 「At that stall, the sweet potato vendor gives you the long, skinny ones if you say 'five sticks please,' and the round ones if you say 'five pieces please'」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is that so. That is knowledge one could never glean from the internet or books」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yet, another question comes to mind. Why is there a need to categorize them?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, if you're eating while walking around outside or want a fluffy texture, go for the round ones」

name: Synn
message: 「And if you want something easy to eat one-handed while reading a book, pick the long, skinny ones, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I-I see. That too is knowledge I did not possess... wisdom, rather」

name: Melilot
message: 「I would very much like to speak with you further and learn more, Sakura-kun, but I shall take my leave for today」

name: Melilot
message: 「I am going to test whether roasted sweet potatoes are suitable as a companion to black tea」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that right」
Melilot-san is acting a little strange today. She keeps volunteering information I didn't even ask about.

name: Melilot
message: 「I will give you one piece... no, one stick of this. Please keep this matter strictly confidential. Understood?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll gladly take it, but... why are you giving it to me?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... It's hush money」

name: Synn
message: 「About what?」

name: Melilot
message: 「U-Ugh...! I have properly handed it over, so farewell」

name: Helena
message: 「You saw it, didn't you」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san!?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right. Melilot's secret, which only I know」

name: Helena
message: 「You see, that girl knows far too little about the outside world」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san does... even though she seems so knowledgeable?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, she lacks firsthand experience--seeing with her own eyes, walking with her own feet, and using all five senses」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be because she's an indoor person?」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, that's part of it, too... though it's also true she had a reason she had to stay inside. Still, you know...」

name: Helena
message: 「You went to all the trouble of being born into this world, so cooping yourself up is such a waste♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Thinking that, we actually studied abroad together once. That's where we met Tamiko-chan」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Helena
message: 「I suppose ever since then... Melilot started coming outside like this. She's busy right now, so she doesn't go very far, though」

name: Helena
message: 「Heehee... Calling the food stall vendors all the way over here is going a bit too far, though」

name: Helena
message: 「You should teach Melilot lots of things too, Synn-chan」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes. Especially you, Synn-chan--it seems like you know plenty of things... that Melilot wouldn't」

name: Synn
message: 「I really don't know... anything that impressive\s01」

name: Helena
message: 「Heehee. Being modest like that is so like you」

name: Helena
message: 「That's not true at all, though. Even I learn so much from everyone」

name: Helena
message: 「In the same way, you ought to learn all sorts of things from Melilot. About Re-Crea, too... right?」
The library Melilot-san manages is a treasure trove of knowledge.
All kinds of literature, the history of the world... and the truth of Re-Crea. Of course, it isn't limited to just that.
Every bit of it is fascinating. What one person can gain all on their own is limited, after all.

name: Synn
message: 「Yes! I'll give it a try!」

name: Helena
message: 「That's the spirit! Here, I'll give you this as a present」

name: Helena
message: 「And with that said, give me something too\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
In the end, we wound up trading the trophy for half a roasted sweet potato.
If I hadn't been there, Helena-san was probably supposed to get the roasted sweet potato... I guess.
